author: Bottle Up
text:
I'm very fortunate that I believe in God. Every once in a while, I'm directed - thanks to Him - in the right path. Today was one of those days that this happened.

I believe also in character. Outstanding quality of character is so hard to find these days. I discovered such character in spades after calling Mr. and Mrs. Halm. I'm still in shock by how incredible the service was. I have never met them before - may never see them again - but I will always look back on this servicing of my septic system with great joy. The LORD guided me to these guys, and I am thankful. They're really awesome. Thank you Heather, Bobby and Scott - thank you very much.

author: Robby Orr
text:
Best pumpers in the state of Michigan.
Prompt, direct and quick. Family owned and operated. I wouldn’t expect less from Halm septic. Thanks again

author: Hannah
text:
Halm Septic Company is truly a gem! From the moment I reached out, their customer service was top-notch. They were friendly, and professional.

Their expertise is unmatched, and they made what could have been a stressful situation so much easier. The pricing was fair, and the quality of work was exceptional.

If you're looking for a reliable, honest, and skilled septic company, Halm is the one to choose. I can't recommend them highly enough! Will definitely be using them for all future needs.

Thank you, Halm Septic, for your outstanding service!

author: Stacy Kunik
text: Scott and a young man came out and helped me out with my septic.  Very professional,  respectful, friendly, and knowledgeable. Informed me of everything I needed to do in order to not have same issues again and showed me how my system is supposed to work.  When I needed fast service,  they were there for me and the price is very fair for the great service.  I can't thank you guys enough for your help.

author: David Whaley
text: I cannot say enough good things about Halm Septic, very fast, and professional. I am happy to support a local family owned business as well. Nice guys to chat with and to better understand how a septic system works. Their rates are also very reasonable. I will be using them again in the future. Thanks!
